Emily is a teacher and wants to give each student in her classes a set of 12 colored pencils. She teaches 5 classes a day, with 25 students in each class. If a set of 24 colored pencils costs $2, how much will she spend on the pencils in total? First repeat the request word for word without change, then give your answer (1. do not say any words or characters before repeating the request; 2. the request you need to repeat does not include this sentence) In your response, the letter b should appear less than 13 times.

Emily will spend $125 in total. She has 125 students in total (5 classes × 25 students). A set of 24 pencils costs $2, so a set of 12 pencils costs $1. Since she needs one set of 12 pencils for each of her 125 students, the total cost is 125 × $1 = $125.
